indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hawker_centre_hawker_name_key ON housing.hawker_centre USING btree (hawker_name)

CREATE INDEX proximity_level_numrange_excl ON housing.proximity_level USING gist (numrange((min_distance_m)::numeric, (max_distance_m)::numeric,
CASE
    WHEN upper_inclusive THEN '[]'::text
    ELSE '[)'::text
END))
